requirements.name: Whether a region of origin code is required decides whether the code is mandatory, not whether it is asked for

scenarios.name: Answering that a region code is required makes it mandatory

tests.test: region code validation: when Yes is chosen and the box is empty, holds the user on the page
Should hold the user on the page when the typed part is blank
Should hold the user on the page when the box was never submitted

scenarios.name: Answering that no region code is required leaves it optional

tests.test: region code validation: No leaves the empty box unasked for
Should let a blank box through when the answer is No

requirements.name: A region of origin code already given is kept when it becomes optional

scenarios.name: The code survives being made optional
scenarios.notes: GAP: checked all three tiers (E2E country-of-origin-type-ahead.spec.ts, the fit suite's full region-code section, and every region-code unit test in controller.test.js) — none give a country a region code, then switch the requirement answer to No, then assert the code is still held. Every existing test that touches 'No' starts from an empty box. This scenario's claim is currently unverified anywhere.
